pages.text: A Radiant Tank is a storage container that can contain up to 16 buckets of a single type of fluid. Using a Radiant Tank on a fluid inventory will transfer the target's fluid inventory into the held Radiant Tank.

When used as an upgrade, a $(l:arcanearchives:items/devouringcharm)Devouring Charm$(/l) causes fluid added to the Tank in excess of its maximum capacity is destroyed.$(br2)$(l:arcanearchives:items/radiantamphora)Radiant Amphorae$(/l) can fill and empty a Radiant Tank from anywhere, as long as the tank is in a loaded chunk.

Using a $(l:arcanearchives:items/scepterrevelation)Scepter of Revelation$(/l) on a Radiant Tank will return what type of fluid is stored, its current and maximum capacity, and how many upgrades have been installed.$(br2)Using a $(l:arcanearchives:items/sceptermanipulation)Scepter of Manipulation$(/l) on a Radiant Tank opens a GUI that allows you to see and modify what upgrades are installed.
When monitored with a Redstone Comparator, a Radiant Tank ouptuts a signal based on how full it is.
Radiant Tanks can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
